checks.why: a method under a composed annotation (an @interface meta-annotated @Test) is a test the runner runs, so what it reaches is credited to it, not to a sibling @Test through a fixture route (#1418)
the meta-annotation is followed transitively: an annotation carrying the composed one is a test marker too

near miss: an annotation that carries no test marker (@Audited) does not make its method a test; it stays a helper, and a Java helper nothing calls credits no test (#1416), so no sibling is listed through it
control: a direct @Test is a test as before
